# sudat/assignments.txt - SCP slot assignments (starter)
# Each machine instruction occupies one SCP slot (control plane).
# Registry convention: BANcode 0x0011A000-0x0011A7FF, WARNcode
# 0x0011A800-0x0011ABFF, COMcode 0x0011AC00-0x0011ADFF, SOFTcode
# 0x0011AE00-0x0011AEFF. Slots below 0x0011A000 are reserved for
# future registry blocks; see control/SCP.txt.
